title: Hogy vagy? — Asking How Someone Is

sections.title: A small-talk staple
sections.content: *Hogy vagy?* reuses the *vagyok/vagy* pattern from Unit 1 — literally "how are-you?" Add *köszönöm* to a reply to soften it, the way English adds "thanks" to "fine".

*Hogy* is doing double duty here — the same word also means "that" elsewhere, as a conjunction ("I think *that*..."). Context always makes it obvious which one is meant, so don't worry about mixing them up.
